confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Vietnamese highland tourist-town pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain; accommodation is less certain because July is peak season for Da Lat and rates vary widely by location and booking channel. Cocktail and wine were estimated from the local price relationship to beer, roughly 4x beer, because direct knowledge is weak. FX: the rate was taken from a search snippet of the RBA homepage (labels were jumbled) and was not verified against the F11.1 daily table, so confirm it there before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Vietnam's mid-sized highland and resort towns, adjusted for Da Lat's lower restaurant and mid-range accommodation costs compared with coastal hubs such as Hoi An and Nha Trang.
